note: A1+ Unit 3 Lesson 3.5, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user approved the A1+ Unit 3 map on 2026-11-20 (A1+ 3.Y follows A1 3.Y, one step each; A1 Unit 3 has sixteen lessons after the alphabet lessons were removed the same day) and asked for the Unit 2 deal: straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. Four new photos show a sister and a brother behind their own birthday cakes, with number candles from A1 3.5's range: 14 and 11, 15 and 13, 12 and 15, 11 and 15. Each sentence is true of one photo only. These photos never go in a four-picture card, because the candle numbers are small at that size; A1 3.5's one-child age photos carry the How old …? retrieval and the four-picture card. Nobody in the photos speaks: the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers.

lesson.title: 3.5 Three years older
lesson.unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
lesson.unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
lesson.goal: Say how much older or younger someone is (She's three years older than him. / He's three years younger than her.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.5 Ages 11-15: A1 asks How old are you? and answers with a number of years old; A1+ 3.5 compares two ages. The one new grammar relationship is a number of years before A1+ 2.11's comparative (She's three years older than him. / He's three years younger than her.), taught against the comparative alone (She's older than him.). Each photo shows a sister and a brother, each behind a birthday cake with number candles, so the difference can be counted. The pronoun after than is A1+ 1.11's him or her.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 3.5 How old …? and eleven to fifteen; A1 2.6 two to four; A1+ 1.5 older and younger; A1+ 1.11 him and her; A1+ 2.11 older than and younger than; A1+ 3.3 he's and she's.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say years with a clear y and a final z sound; keep older than and younger than as one group, with than unstressed. Do not require native-like speed.
